123:t_1:3.en: ～ $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room ～

123:t_1:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...Capturing $$セントラル・ベース$$ will carry great significance in our coming fights against the $$新地球皇国$$.」

123:t_1:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Here in North America, where the Empire and the $$地球連邦$$ are evenly matched, a victory at this base should be a major turning point.」

123:t_1:8.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「At the same time, this battle is a perfect chance to gather intelligence on the $$サイデリアル$$.」

123:t_1:9.en:
$$オットー$$
「We've been fighting the Empire in various ways for these two months, but we have far too little information on the enemy.」

123:t_1:10.en:
$$オットー$$
「That they're trying to build a system that draws $$次元力$$ out of the Earth through the $$レイライン$$ is, after all, only conjecture.」

123:t_1:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The Empire's objectives, scale, strategy... To learn all of that, we must make sure the assault on $$セントラル・ベース$$ succeeds.」

123:t_1:12.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Is there any guarantee that taking that base down will actually get us that much information?」

123:t_1:13.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「At the very least, there's no doubt that $$セントラル・ベース$$ is the Empire's largest stronghold on this North American continent.」

123:t_1:14.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The Empire covers this Earth with $$レイライン$$ and regional bases, centered on the imperial capital $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

123:t_1:15.en:
$n
「I hear it looks as if a spider's web has been cast over the entire Earth.」

123:t_1:16.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That's right. And looked at another way, you could say the Empire rules the Earth with points and lines.」

123:t_1:17.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Among those points, $$セントラル・ベース$$ has a special significance, so we can assume it's directly linked to $$ラース・バビロン$$ as well.」

123:t_1:18.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I intend to break into that network and obtain as much information as I can.」

123:t_1:19.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「In that case, we'd have to do the cracking before the battle for the base is decided.」

123:t_1:21.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Because if the Empire side realizes it's going to lose, it might destroy the base facilities with its own hands.」

123:t_1:22.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So that means somebody has to get into the base in the middle of the fighting, right?」

123:t_1:23.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If that's the only way, I'll do it.」

123:t_1:24.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'll go with you, $$ティエリア$$.」

123:t_1:25.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「With you coming along, I feel much better.」

123:t_1:26.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ティエリア$$. For the sake of our future fights against the Empire, too.」

123:t_1:27.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I also intend to look into 《$$ヴェーダ$$》, which they took from us, as much as I can.」

123:t_1:28.en:
$$オットー$$
「The regular army will launch a diversion in the surrounding area. For their sake, too, we will make this operation... a success, no matter what.」

123:t_1:31.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「What is it, $$フェルト$$?」

123:t_1:32.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Just now... a message came in from the $$地球連邦軍$$. They say Tokyo, in 《$$新日本$$》, has fallen.」

123:t_1:34.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Wait a second...! $$ゼロ$$ is in $$新日本$$, isn't he!?」

123:t_1:35.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「I'd heard he and General $$藤堂$$ were taking command and fighting the Empire, but...」

123:t_1:37.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The $$連邦軍$$ haven't grasped the details either, but now that Tokyo, the capital, has fallen, they say $$新日本$$'s chain of command has collapsed completely.」

123:t_1:39.en:
$$オットー$$
「Damn the Empire... So they've finally launched an offensive against the Pacific Rim area too.」

123:t_1:40.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「In that case, capturing $$セントラル・ベース$$ will mean even more.」

123:t_1:41.en:
$$アムロ$$
「By liberating North America, we strike a blow at the Empire and at the same time check their strategy...」

123:t_1:42.en:
$$オットー$$
「Yes... We have to hurry.」

123:t_1:43.en:
$$レイアム$$
「In 24 hours, we will launch a breakthrough of the defensive line. Until then, every one of you finish your unit's maintenance and stand by.」

123:t_1:47.en:
$n
「I know. Now that $$新日本$$ has fallen, Japan will come under the Empire's attack sooner or later...」

123:t_1:48.en:
$n
「That's exactly why we have to make the $$セントラル・ベース$$ assault operation... a success.」

123:t_1:50.en:
$$エマ$$
「The roles of guardian have completely reversed, haven't they?」

123:t_1:52.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Heh... now that $n has gotten stronger, Miss $$スズネ$$ doesn't have to worry about the age gap anymore.」

123:t_1:53.en:
$$スズネ$$
「W-wait a minute...! What are you saying, $$フォウ$$!?」

123:t_1:54.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Lieutenant $$エマ$$ said so too. That when it comes to men, you really have to let them take the lead to some extent.」

123:t_1:56.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Sorry for saying something unnecessary before an operation.」

123:t_1:57.en:
$$フォウ$$
「But it's right before a big battle. I think being honest is important, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

123:t_1:58.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Honestly... $$フォウ$$ is... ! Say something too, $n!」

123:t_1:60.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Doesn't look like you mind it all that much.」

123:t_1:61.en:
$$ファ$$
「Are you really okay with being treated like that?」

123:t_1:62.en:
$n
「Until now I've done nothing but depend on other people. So I'm a little bit happy.」

123:t_1:63.en:
$$スズネ$$
「In that case, I wonder if I should relax and lean on you, $n.」

123:t_1:65.en:
$n
「It's not that I mind, but... you know... I need to get mentally prepared...」

123:t_1:66.en:
$$エマ$$
「Judging by that, you're still a long way from being able to handle a grown woman.」

123:t_1:68.en:
$$ファ$$
「Honestly, $$カミーユ$$. You're a kid yourself.」

123:t_1:69.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Before you talk about $n, $$カミーユ$$, you're the one who should try harder.」

123:t_1:70.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Hard enough that you can handle me, not just $$ファ$$.」

123:t_1:73.en:
$n
「That's exactly the same reaction I had.」

123:t_1:74.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're right. I guess I still have a long way to go, too.」

123:t_1:75.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Heh... do your best too, $$カミーユ$$.」

123:t_1:76.en:
$n
「How about it, Miss $$スズネ$$? Do you feel a little less tense?」

123:t_1:77.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank you. Thanks to you, $n, and everyone, I can fight too.」

123:t_1:80.en:
$n
「I've stopped cowering in fear. I'll overcome it.」

123:t_1:81.en:
$n
「Doing that is my fight right now.」
